stemMd: Two similar triangles have corresponding side lengths in ratio 3:5. What is the ratio of their areas?
explanationMd: Similarity scales every length by 5/3 from the smaller to the larger triangle. Area uses two length dimensions, so the ratio is 3²:5² = 9:25. Cubing would apply to volumes of similar solids.

distractorRationale.a: Area scales with the square of the length factor.
distractorRationale.c: This is only an equivalent length ratio.
distractorRationale.e: This cubes the length ratio, appropriate to volume scaling.
distractorRationale.b: This reverses the ratio and still uses linear scaling.
